note: The pop-up of every heading of the claims list, and the plain reason shown under an extraction confidence value (one line per check or flag word the server names in confidence.failed). One file; George checks the wording here.
label_mismatch_question: The name of this figure isn't next to it on the page. Which is it?

columns.Type: The kind of figure the app took this to be: Revenue, ARR, MRR, Customers, Users, Churn, NRR, CAC, Market size and so on. A segment follows the type when one is set ("Revenue · Platform Subscriptions"), and "part of ARR 2025 total" says the figure is one part of a total stated elsewhere. "Other" means the app could not place it as a company claim; it stays out of the register. Change it with Edit.
columns.Value: The figure as the deck prints it, with its unit or currency. A range reads "from to". A row of a table shows one value for each period. A figure in another currency than the audit's shows its converted value on hover.
columns.Period: The date or period the figure refers to, read from the page ("Q3 2025", "Dec 2025"). "no date" means the page states none; set it with Edit. A note under it says where the date was read from when it is not the figure's own cell.
columns.Claim in the deck: The text of the cell the figure was read from. Under it: "Label from" is the text the app took as the name of the figure, and "Date from" is the text it took the period from. These are the deck's own words.
columns.Source: The file and the slide or page the figure was read from, with the table, row and column or the cell. Several lines mean the same figure is stated in several places.
columns.Extraction confidence: How well the app read this figure from the deck. Not a statement about whether it is true. High: the figure was found on the page and every check passed. Medium: found on the page, with a note under it (for example the period or the currency was assumed) or one check failed. Low: not found on the page, or a review flag, or two or more checks failed. Analyst-entered: you added it. Analyst-edited: you changed it, so it is not scored.
columns.Status: Where the claim stands. Needs your attention: a check asks about it, so it waits for you and is not yet in the register. In the register: it is tested against the data. Entered by the app: the page checks passed, so the app put it in the register on its own. Edited: you changed it. Rejected: you excluded it; it stays on record and is not used.
columns.Action: Keep (tick): confirm the claim is one the company makes, so it is tested and enters the register. Edit (pencil): correct the figure, type, unit or date; the claim is tested again. Reject (cross): exclude a figure that is not a company claim. Undo: restore the status a rejected claim had.

reasons.High: High – every check passed, and the figure is found on the page
reasons.Analyst-entered: Analyst-entered – you entered this claim, so the app does not score it
reasons.Analyst-edited: Analyst-edited – you edited this claim, so the app does not score it
reasons.not matched: the app could not find this figure in the cell it cited
reasons.no date: no period is stated for this figure
reasons.no unit: no unit or currency is stated
reasons.no heading: nothing next to the figure or above it names what it is
reasons.not corroborated: the figure is stated in one place only in the deck
reasons.value not on page: the value is not in the cell the model cited
reasons.currency assumed: the currency is not printed next to the figure; the app assumed it
reasons.unit assumed: the unit is not printed next to the figure; the app assumed it
reasons.scenario label not on page: the scenario (best, realistic, worst) is not written near the figure
reasons.period not on page: the period is not written on the page
reasons.page out of range: the page cited does not exist in the document
reasons.use-of-funds share: the figure looks like a share of the money raised, not a plan figure
reasons.acquisition channel: the figure looks like a customer acquisition channel, not a company metric
reasons.turnover not revenue: the figure is turnover, which may not be revenue
reasons.year under bar differs: the year printed under the bar differs from the period given
reasons.pipeline column: the figure sits in a pipeline column, not in revenue
reasons.axis tick: the figure looks like a mark on a chart axis, not a claim
reasons.not a plan line: the line looks like funds raised or market data, not a plan figure
reasons.matches analyst claim: you already entered a claim with this value
reasons.basis and scenario disagree: the basis (actual, projection) and the scenario do not fit together
reasons.basis conflicts with period: the period is in the future but the figure is called actual, or the reverse
reasons.cell corrected: the figure was found in a different cell than the one cited
reasons.sign not on page: the page prints no minus sign; the figure is shown as printed
reasons.period from page heading: the period comes from the page heading, not from the figure's own label
reasons.period from another cell: the period comes from another cell of the page, not from the figure's own cell
reasons.period is a range: the page gives a range of years, which is not one period
reasons.growth dated to start year: the growth is dated to the year it starts from
reasons.label mismatch: the name of the figure is not next to it on the page
reasons.sources disagree: the figure's own sources state different periods
reasons.source ambiguous: more than one label or period fits this figure
reasons.source not associated: no label or period on the page can be tied to this figure
reasons.extraction incomplete: part of the page could not be read, so the figure may be elsewhere

year_label_below: the year label printed below the figure is {year}
